title_zh: 职场剧：新人的办公室生活
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (15/20): Workplace Dramas, a Newcomer's Office Life
note_en: 既……又…… (jì... yòu...) links two qualities that are true at the same time: 对工作既充满热情，又感到有些迷茫 "both full of enthusiasm for the job and a little lost." English uses "both ... and," but Chinese puts 既 and 又 right before each verb or adjective phrase, not before nouns, so the pattern describes states, not things.
